verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a robotics middleware framework, and its ecosystem could plausibly ship a way to consume MCP servers' tools, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP, connecting to MCP servers, or any LLM tool-use client. The docs cover only DDS pub/sub, services, actions, CLI introspection, security and QoS, none of which is this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
